# Daily Briefing – Monday 27 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 4,663 steps and a near-perfect calorie balance at 2,346 kcal burned. The real concern is that 5.1 hours of sleep; that's too short and it's showing in your HRV dropping to 92ms against your 100-119ms baseline. Your body is telling you it needed more rest than it got.

The good news is your resting HR of 48bpm and stress score of 24/100 suggest you're physiologically calm — this likely isn't overtraining, just under-sleeping. If today has an easy or moderate session planned, go ahead but keep intensity controlled. Hard intervals? Push those 24 hours if you can.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours — it'll do more for your Chester prep than any single session. Hit your 175g protein today to support recovery, and consider cutting screens an hour before bed.
